scope: Read-only copy and visual review; no product/client/business/sanitizer execution, source edit, font installation or global font-file search.

observations.002_C: Chinese friend-name, group initial/name and connected footer are already normal in the same whole screenshot.

stable_identity_and_terminal.evidence: Both selected captures in captures.json record these same full original process identities and terminal sizes.

text_vs_pixel_evidence.first_three_lines_result: Same Chinese history-name Unicode and ANSI styles, different physical glyph pixels. Initial terminal capture contains correct history/navigation/connected Chinese, not replacement square characters.

terminal_environment.config: Software frontend, X11, Unicode version9, 120x40, 12pt/96DPI, fallback DejaVu Sans Mono -> Lily Han Sans HW SC -> Noto Color Emoji, no tab/scroll bar or padding.
terminal_environment.fc_match_observed: LilyHanSans.otc: Lily Han Sans HW SC / Regular
terminal_environment.log: Only WARN unhandled SetDecPrivateMode 2031 and unknown CSI ?996n at16:27:22.067; no recorded font-load error.
terminal_environment.limits: fc-match proves the requested family resolves in fontconfig, not exactly which font/glyph WezTerm actually used for the first B frame. Extension warnings alone do not prove the glyph problem.

classification.leading_inference: WezTerm fallback/glyph cache and frame/repaint timing interaction is more consistent with unchanged correct text/styles and normal later pixels than corrupt TUI Unicode output.
cannot_determine: Whether the first capture was merely too early
Whether delayed font fallback or terminal glyph atlas invalidation caused the recovery
Whether TUI/FTXUI damage optimization and terminal repaint interact
Whether the initial failure is reproducible under another unchanged native run
classification.safe_followup_if_authorized: Retain the anomalous first frame. Sample an unchanged page after visual settling before any navigation, compare whole PNG and contemporaneous same Unicode/ANSI output, then compare the normal user-navigation redraw; do not force product repaint or change dependencies merely to hide the evidence.

a11y_boundary.observed: Known Daily nodes traversal has catch-and-ignore paths for geometry/text/child/node/application exceptions; this selected runtime scope exposes no *a11y* error log.
a11y_boundary.must_not_claim: No .a11y error file or clean-looking saved tree does not establish zero read errors. Visible-parent-list plus path selectors can support the actual selected target, not certify complete error-free AT-SPI traversal.
a11y_boundary.note: No menu accessibility or speech correctness claim is derived from these screenshots.
